question: How does the setting-forth abandon its own form?
premises: All object-effect merged within awakening, insofar merged, from exuberant activity.
In the interval of the awakening-flame-mass, that setting-forth as it were abandons its own form.
inference: Merged object-effect sets forth self-form-abandoned in the flame-interval.
plain_english: The whole object-effect merged within awakening — insofar as merged, from exuberant activity — in the interval of the flame-mass of awakening, that setting-forth as it were abandons its own form.
